item.title: Delhi Dangal Warriors Beat Punjab Royals 5–4 to Seal PWL 2026 Semifinal Spot
item.description: Delhi Dangal Warriors clinched a dramatic 5–4 win over Punjab Royals at the Noida Indoor Stadium to secure a semifinal berth in PWL 2026, with Turan Bayramov delivering a match-winning performance.

item.title: De Kock’s Borrowed Bat Century Seals Series Win for South Africa Against West Indies
item.description: Quinton de Kock smashed a career-best 115 with a borrowed bat as South Africa chased down 221 to beat West Indies by seven wickets and clinch the T20I series at Centurion.

item.title: PT Usha's Husband Passes Away; PM Modi Expresses Condolences
item.description: Indian Olympic Association President: V. Srinivasan, husband of Rajya Sabha member and Indian Olympic Association President P.T. Usha, passed away in the early hours of Friday.

item.title: England Look To Fine Tune For T20 World Cup With Sri Lanka Series

item.title: IOA Chief PT Usha’s Husband V Srinivasan Dies At 64; PM Modi Expresses Condolences
item.description: Rajya Sabha MP PT Usha: V Srinivasan, husband of Indian Olympic Association president and Rajya Sabha MP PT Usha, passed away on Friday at the age on 64. Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke to the athlete and expressed his condolences on the passing away of her husband.

item.title: Virat Kohli's Instagram Account Reinstated After Brief Disappearance
item.description: Virat Kohli: Star Indian cricketer Virat Kohli's official Instagram account was reinstated on Friday morning, following a brief disappearance that left fans baffled and buzzing online.

item.title: Chennaiyin FC Sign Spanish Forward Inigo Martin Ahead Of The New Season
item.description: Spanish Forward Inigo Martin: Chennaiyin FC have completed the signing of Spanish attacker Inigo Martin, with the 26-year-old set to embark on his first stint in Indian football.

item.title: Pakistan Skipper Salman Agha Confirms He Will Bat No. 3 In T20 WC
item.description: Salman Ali Agha: As Pakistan provided hints to a new-look top six during the first T20I against Australia, captain Salman Ali Agha has confirmed he will bat at No. 3 for the side during the upcoming ICC Men's T20 World Cup.

item.title: Gadecki And Peers Become First Pair In 37 Years To Defend Aus Open Mixed Doubles Title
item.description: Rod Laver Arena: Hometown wildcards Olivia Gadecki and John Peers became the first pairing in 37-year to defend their Australian Open mixed doubles crown here on Friday.

item.title: NZ Add Sears In T20 WC Squad As Travelling Reserve
item.description: ICC T20 World Cup: Pace-bowler Ben Sears will join the New Zealand squad as a travelling reserve for the ICC T20 World Cup, starting on February 7 in India and Sri Lanka, NZC said on Friday.
